description: This file is a shell script for testing Git status and merge scenarios, containing test cases and setup scripts for a Git repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to succeed.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified parameters.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the system clock for testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the test suite as completed.
